notes.title: Politon is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

We are so excited to announce that *Politon, our new turn-based strategy game, is out now!*

"Defeat your friends online by employing new strategies or enjoy single-player game modes, Politon offers a variety of hex-based maps with different terrains and stories.”

During the long development process, our whole team knew that Politon was going to be a game that we will play with pleasure. Today, we see that all our teammates play Politon with passion and relish. Achieving this creates various deep emotions in us. This is the day we release our first game on Steam, so we are very excited!

Many thanks to our team and those who supported us during this period, we love Pinq!

Cheers
Arda & Hakan

notes.title: Politon will release into Early Access on August 23rd, 2023!
notes.content:
[h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]

Player feedback is crucial for us to make Politon the best it can be. Although we are very close to the full version, we want to see our shortcomings based on player opinions and continue our development accordingly. Throughout this process, we will be adding more content, improvements, and visual enhancements to all planned game modes. Joining us early will allow you to express your ideas for the full version and enjoy early good experiences in the world of Politon.

[h2]Features available in Early Access[/h2]

Online Multiplayer (Play with Steam friends)
Single Player Scenario
Online Challenges
Single Player Skirmish

Have fun knights!
